description: What our minds imagine, Our hands create.
summary: It Works on Paper! lets users design, launch, and operate an end-to-end Earth-observation space mission. Grounded in real aerospace physics and NASA datasets, it translates complex mission-architecture trade-offs into an accessible, interactive sandbox.
details:
Our project use Pixel-by-Pixel Rocket & Satellite Computer Assisted Design to help students understand space missions and the importance of these projects to our society. We utilized Javascript and HTML5 as our language with Rapier as our physics engine.

We aim to visualize the science behind spaceflight while unleashing creativity of the students who wish to reach for the stars.
